gist: Bulk mail: six newsletters (May to late Oct 2026), automated notifications such as backups, security checks and parcel notices, shopping receipts, and spam. Nothing in the newsletters or notifications needs action. Receipts run to 29 Oct, and several damaged-item returns have refunds promised but not shown. Suspicious items include two possible duplicate kettles and a possible duplicate rain jacket, and some parcel and calendar senders do not match their subjects, so treat unexpected parcel mail with caution. Spam and phishing are filed as spam and not acted on.
